verdict.rationale: AWS publishes official open-source MCP servers under the awslabs GitHub organization, and a probe confirms that an official MCP server is documented there, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence amounts to a title and a probe hit, with no detail on setup or behavior. Missing for 10: details on which AWS services the servers cover, connection/configuration and authentication steps for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
